text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I take pride in my front-running style.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I turn my legs. No 
matter how out of breath I get. I'll stay 
stubborn until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Even so—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—You saying doing it that way will bring 
me closer to being the world's best?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: *cough*... *wheeze*, *hack*...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Cut that face out. They're gonna 
see right through you on screen."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...My companions are watching this match.

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Tap! You were amazing!" "You can take on 
the world, Tap!"

In the comment feed displayed in the VR 
space, comments that seemed to be from Tap 
Dance City's friends were scrolling by.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—These legs are packed with everyone's 
hopes and expectations.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Like I'd ever let them think, even for a 
split second, that their dreams are out of 
reach!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: My show can still go on.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—If only for this year, by placing that 
dream entirely upon you guys.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, can you hear me?! My fans! My 
comrades!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—I won't be Japan's representative! I'm 
declining that spot this year!!

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"No way... Huh... Tap?" "Why...? If it was 
you...!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This year, I really want to bet all my 
dreams on <chrname>!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"So from here on, I'll be supporting <chrname> and 
teaching her everything I know!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Doesn't it look like fun? We're going to 
take on the world as one united team with 
them!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer?

In contrast to the wide smile on her lips, 
Tap Dance City's eyes were completely 
serious.
choice_data_list:
...Ah, let's make our dream come true—you 
and I together.

...Yeah, let's make our dream come true 
together with you.

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"So, that means Tap is gonna be a 
teacher?" "Isn't that right? So if <chrname> wins 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—"

text_block_list.name: Stream Comment
text_block_list.text:
"If Tap trained the best in the world, 
then she's the best in the world too...!"

...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

I lined up there alongside <chrname> and Tap Dance 
City, making the three of us.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will read out the names of the 
Umamusume chosen to represent us. The 
first is—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...So basically, while we're on the away 
trip, I'll be supporting you guys.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's tandem running or giving 
advice, just have me do whatever you want 
me to do."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. Same to you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm entrustin' the greatest romance in the 
world to you guys for now.
